# Zero Mouse Clicks

> Free, open-source web tool that turns the floor plan image from a developer's brochure or a real-estate listing into an architectural plan set: eight A3 drawing sheets in one PDF. Three tiny segmentation models read the image and explicit rules draw it, entirely in the visitor's browser (no upload, no LLM, no tokens).

The plan set contains: G-001 cover and index, A-101 floor plan with dimensions and room areas, A-102 area, finish, door and window schedules, A-103 floor finishes, A-104 schematic electrical layout, A-105 furniture layout, A-201 kitchen section and A-202 bathroom section. Scale comes from the room dimensions printed on the plan or from the declared area (m² or sq ft). Under active development with frequent releases. Marketing plans are not to scale and sections and electrical points are assumptions, so every sheet says to verify dimensions on site. Licence: Apache-2.0 (code and model weights).

## Use it from an AI assistant (beta)

Any assistant can hand the user a link that loads a floor plan image and starts the plan set in their browser:
https://zeromouseclicks.com/?plan=<direct image URL, URL-encoded>&area=<number, optional>&unit=<m2|sqft, optional>  (add go=0 to load without starting)
Use the private (net interior) area in m², or the gross area in sq ft. The image must be a 2D floor plan (JPG, PNG or WEBP).
MCP server (remote, Streamable HTTP, no authentication): https://ebqxcaelgmxofwtofrdc.supabase.co/functions/v1/zmc-ai/mcp  tools: find_floor_plans(page_url), plan_set_link(image_url, area?, unit?)
Details: https://zeromouseclicks.com/beta
